The figure presents a comparison of the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry (industry, construction, trade, and other services) in 2021, expressed as percentages of the total economy. The figure consists of three donut charts, each representing one of the measured variables: number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover. Each chart is divided into four sectors, representing the four industries. In the first chart (number of enterprises), the sectors are labeled "Industry" (61%, 19.0 mln), "Construction" (8%, 2.4 mln), "Trade" (12%, 3.7 mln), and "Other Services" (19%, 5.9 mln). The second chart (number of persons employed) shows "Industry" (51%, 80.2 mln), "Construction" (21%, 33.0 mln), "Trade" (9%, 13.4 mln), and "Other Services" (19%, 29.5 mln). The third chart (turnover) displays "Industry" (31%, 9.9 tln), "Construction" (33%, 10.6 tln), "Trade" (6%, 1.9 tln), and "Other Services" (31%, 9.9 tln). Each sector is colored differently: Industry is orange, Construction is blue, Trade is red, and Other Services is purple. A legend is provided at the bottom of the figure, associating each color with its corresponding industry. The sectors within each chart do not appear to be arranged in any specific order. Percentage values and absolute values are displayed within each sector.
